entities.name: Franz Ferdinand von Rummel

entities.summary: Franz Ferdinand von Rummel was educator and religious tutor of Emperor Joseph I, Bishop of Tinin, Provost of Ardagger and Wrocław, and was from 1706 to 1716 the Prince-Bishop of Vienna.
